_comment: W19. Names for everything, so the owner and I can say where a thing is instead of giving each other coordinates. This file is read by the map (scripts/ui/map_panel.gd) and by Places.region_at, and it is the only place a name lives: nothing here is duplicated into a site id. North is -Z in this project, which is how every site id already named itself, so the compass follows the data rather than the other way round.

regions.name: Mournhearth
regions.note: The bowl the Mirror Pond lies in, and the one place in the Vale with a road through every side of it.

regions.name: The Drowned March
regions.note: Flat country gone to water. The river crosses the whole of it and takes whoever tries the crossing.

regions.name: Morrowfield
regions.note: The castle's own ground, raised sixteen metres over everything round it and walled in cut stone.

regions.name: The Greenwatch
regions.note: The forest road and Greenwatch Holt either side of it, watched from a tower that has not been manned in years.

regions.name: Wyrdreach
regions.note: A hidden valley with one gap in its wall, and a town inside the gap that does not advertise itself.

regions.name: The Still Meadow
regions.note: Open grass, three graves and a ring of stones. Nothing has happened here for a long time.

regions.name: Hollowmere Downs
regions.note: Hollowmere and its crofts, orchards, mill and graveyard: the largest living place in the Vale.

regions.name: The Ashen Flats
regions.note: Farmland on the way out, and the Overlook above it, which is the only place you can see the whole Vale from.

regions.name: The Fallow Marches
regions.note: Fields nobody has worked in living memory, a shrine at the rim for the people who left, and somewhere in the trees a village that would rather you did not find it.

places.name: Castle Morrow
places.note: The seat that gave this country its name.

places.name: Hollowmere
places.note: Sixty buildings, a mill, a smithy and a bell.

places.name: Wyrdhollow
places.note: Six houses inside a ring of high ground with one gap.

places.name: Thornhollow
places.note: A village in a clearing, walled by stone and hidden by wood. Nobody here wanted to be found.

places.name: Riverend
places.note: Eight houses on the bank, as near the water as anyone dares.

places.name: Mirror Pond
places.note: Eleven metres deep at the middle and perfectly still.

places.name: The Drowned Light
places.note: A broken light on an islet, still lit at the top.

places.name: The Overlook
places.note: Twenty-two metres up. The whole Vale, from one place.

places.name: Thornwood
places.note: Three thousand trees round a clearing you cannot see into.

places.name: The Girdle
places.note: A ring of crag and standing stone, broken at one bearing.

places.name: Wyrm's Rest
places.note: What fell here, fenced off, with a fire at the fence.

places.name: The Sunken Wheel
places.note: A hoop of worked stone going into the ground.

places.name: The Quiet Bell
places.note: A chapel with a lit altar and a bell nobody rings.

places.name: The Siege Ground
places.note: Pickets, graves and cold fires below the castle wall.

places.name: The Sunken Field
places.note: A field that filled and was never drained.

places.name: The Cutting
places.note: Where the road was cut through rock rather than round it.

places.name: The Cold Watch
places.note: Five storeys, four of them standing.

places.name: The Green Watch
places.note: The tower over the forest road.

places.name: The Still Watch
places.note: The tower over the meadow, and the quietest of the three.

places.name: The Mere Graves
places.note: Hollowmere buries its own at the edge of the orchard.

places.name: Ashfarm
places.note: The last farmhouse before the fallow ground.

places.name: Maren's Croft
places.note: One cottage, one tally scratched into the lintel.

places.name: The Hermit's Shack
places.note: Far from the road on purpose.

places.name: The Edge Shrine
places.note: A tablet at the rim, facing out of the Vale.

places.name: The North Watch
places.note: A watch hut with a fire on its roof, over the river country.

places.name: The Fisher's Shack
places.note: Nets, and no boat.

places.name: Greenwatch Holt
places.note: The Greenwatch was named for its wood and had no wood in it: a watchtower, a forest road and four camps on open ground.

places.name: Mirewood
places.note: North of the river, between the cairns and the bank.

places.name: The Long Hedge
places.note: West, under the Overlook.

waters.name: The Morrow Race
waters.note: Fast, narrow and straight down off the castle ground.

waters.name: The Wide Water
waters.note: The river at its broadest, between two cut hills, with a span hanging over it on no supports.

waters.name: Riverend Bank
waters.note: The only reach anyone has built on.

waters.name: The Last Mouth
waters.note: Where the river leaves the Vale and does not come back.
